epaPerPlay.label: EPA per play
epaPerPlay.formula: mean(epa) over plays with pass == 1 or rush == 1 and epa present
epaPerPlay.explain: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the points a team could expect to score on that drive, from nflfastR's model. Above 0 is good for the offense; +0.1 per play is strong, -0.1 is poor.

successRate.label: Success rate
successRate.formula: share of the same plays with epa > 0
successRate.explain: How often a play left the offense better off than before it. Around 45% is typical; 50%+ is very good.

explosiveRate.label: Explosive play rate
explosiveRate.formula: (dropbacks gaining >= 20 yards + designed runs gaining >= 10 yards) / plays
explosiveRate.explain: Share of plays that broke big: passes of 20+ yards or runs of 10+ yards.

yardsPerPlay.label: Yards per play
yardsPerPlay.formula: total yards / (rushes + dropbacks), excluding two-point tries
yardsPerPlay.explain: Average yards on each offensive snap, sacks included.

thirdDown.label: Third-down conversions
thirdDown.explain: How often the offense kept the drive alive on third down.

fourthDown.label: Fourth-down conversions
fourthDown.explain: Successful fourth-down attempts out of all tries (punts and kicks are not tries).

redZone.label: Red-zone touchdowns
redZone.formula: drives ending in a touchdown / drives with a snap at or inside the opponent 20
redZone.explain: When a drive reached the opponent's 20, how often it ended in a touchdown.

turnovers.label: Turnovers
turnovers.formula: interceptions thrown + fumbles lost (fumbled_1_team == team and fumble_lost == 1)
turnovers.explain: Possessions given away. Each one typically costs about four expected points.

timeOfPossession.label: Time of possession
timeOfPossession.formula: sum of drive_time_of_possession over the team's drives
timeOfPossession.explain: How long the team had the ball.

pointsPerDrive.label: Points per drive
pointsPerDrive.formula: offensive points (TD 6 + PAT/2pt, FG 3) / drives, excluding end-of-half kneels

winProbability.label: Win probability
winProbability.formula: nflfastR home_wp before each play; final point is the actual result
winProbability.explain: The model's estimate of each team's chance to win at that moment, based on score, time, field position, down and distance. It is an estimate, not a fact.

epaFactors.label: What decided it
epaFactors.formula: net EPA by phase: passing, rushing, turnovers, special teams, other (penalties)
epaFactors.explain: Splits the game's expected-points margin into phases so you can see which part of the game produced the result. Values are in expected points.
